tools.name: get_caption_tracks
tools.description: Read caption-track timing and runtime item metadata. Premiere Pro UXP 26.3 does not expose user-edited caption text, so each item returns text: null and textAvailable: false; getName() is returned separately as kind metadata. Uses the active sequence when sequence_id is omitted.

sequence_id.description: Sequence name or ID. Uses the active sequence if omitted.

tools.name: get_clip_transcript
tools.description: Read existing Premiere transcripts from clip project items and return normalized word timing in seconds.

item_name.description: Exact project item name. Scans all transcript-bearing clip items when omitted.

tools.name: probe_caption_item
tools.description: Diagnostic only: inspect the runtime API surface of the first caption track item (property names, text getter probes, component chain). Remove once the caption text path is confirmed.

sequence_id.description: Sequence name or ID. Uses the active sequence if omitted.

tools.name: remove_transition
tools.description: Remove the end-edge video transition from a specific video clip using the official UXP transition Action. Only the live-verified end position is exposed; start and both remain blocked pending separate disposable-project verification.

node_id.description: Synthetic UXP video TrackItem ID returned by a read tool.

position.description: Live-verified clip edge whose transition will be removed (default and only accepted value: end).

tools.name: export_open_timeline_io
tools.description: Export the active sequence as OpenTimelineIO through Adobe ProjectConverter. This writes a file and is not undoable.

tools.name: get_media_encoder_info
tools.description: Report whether Adobe Media Encoder is installed according to the official EncoderManager.

tools.name: list_media_encoder_events
tools.description: List bounded Adobe Media Encoder events received after this UXP plugin registered its official EncoderManager listeners. This is an event journal, not a queue snapshot.

after_event_id.description: Return events with a larger local event ID (default: 0).

job_id.description: Optional exact AME job ID filter.

tools.name: launch_media_encoder
tools.description: Launch Adobe Media Encoder asynchronously through the official EncoderManager. This changes external application state and is not undoable.

tools.name: set_encoder_xmp_options
tools.description: Set Adobe Media Encoder embedded and/or sidecar XMP export options. At least one option is required; the two direct calls are non-atomic and not undoable.

tools.name: get_installed_mogrt_path
tools.description: Read Premiere's official local directory path for installed Adobe MOGRT files.

tools.name: rename_caption_track
tools.description: Rename an existing caption track with the official CaptionTrack Action and verify the name by read-back.

tools.name: set_caption_track_mute
tools.description: Set mute on an existing caption track with the official direct UXP API and verify the value by read-back. This write is not undoable.

tools.name: list_transcription_languages
tools.description: List the transcription languages exposed by Adobe's official Transcript API.

tools.name: has_transcript
tools.description: Report whether a clip project item has an existing Premiere transcript through Adobe's official Transcript API.

tools.name: set_source_monitor_position
tools.description: Set the open Source Monitor clip position in seconds with the official UXP API and verify exact ticks by read-back. This write is not undoable.

tools.name: is_premiere_project
tools.description: Check whether a path is recognized as a Premiere project by Adobe's official Project.isProject API.

tools.name: open_sequence
tools.description: Open a sequence in the active project with Adobe's official Project.openSequence API. This changes Premiere UI state and is not undoable.

tools.name: pause_growing_media
tools.description: Pause or resume growing-media updates for the active Premiere project through the official direct API. This write is not undoable and has no read-back API.

tools.name: has_object_mask
tools.description: Check whether the active project or a sequence contains an Adobe object mask using the official ObjectMaskUtils API.

tools.name: get_project_ingest_settings
tools.description: Read whether ingest is enabled for the active project through Adobe's official ProjectSettings API.

tools.name: set_project_ingest_enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable ingest for the active project with Adobe's official ProjectSettings Action and verify the value by read-back.

tools.name: set_project_scratch_disk_mode
tools.description: Set one project scratch-disk category to Adobe's official same-as-project or My Documents symbolic location and verify the resulting path. Arbitrary paths are not exposed.

tools.name: subscribe_premiere_events
tools.description: Subscribe to bounded Adobe Premiere project, sequence, operation, track, or snap events. The journal begins at subscription time and is not a current-state snapshot.

sequence_id.description: Sequence name or ID for sequence or track-targeted subscriptions. Uses the active sequence when omitted.

tools.name: list_premiere_events
tools.description: Read the bounded 200-entry journal of official Premiere events captured after subscription. This is an event journal, not a project or timeline state snapshot.

tools.name: unsubscribe_premiere_events
tools.description: Remove exact official Premiere event listeners previously registered by this plugin. Omitting groups removes every listener owned by this journal.

tools.name: import_clip_transcript_json
tools.description: Import bounded external transcript JSON into one clip project item using Adobe Transcript Actions. Existing transcripts are replaced only when explicitly requested. This is undoable but destructive to prior transcript state.

tools.name: get_project_panel_selection
tools.description: Read bounded Project panel selections from the active project or all open project views through Adobe ProjectUtils. Native paths are intentionally omitted.

tools.name: get_app_preference
tools.description: Read one of Adobe's three officially exposed Premiere application preferences: automatic peak generation, workspace import, or Quick Start display.

tools.name: set_app_preference
tools.description: Set one of Adobe's three officially exposed Premiere application preferences with session or persistent scope and read it back. This is application-global and not undoable.

tools.name: get_active_production_scratch_disks
tools.description: Read all six official scratch-disk categories from the active Premiere Production, or report that no Production is active.

tools.name: is_after_effects_installed
tools.description: Report whether After Effects is installed according to Adobe's official Premiere UXP utility API.

tools.name: get_custom_properties
tools.description: Read one exact official custom property from a project or sequence. Premiere 26.3 has no property-ID enumeration API, so omitting property_id returns that limitation explicitly.

tools.name: clear_custom_property
tools.description: Clear one exact custom property from a project or sequence using an official undoable Action and verify that it no longer exists.

tools.name: get_project_item_lut_info
tools.description: Read the exact input and embedded LUT IDs from one clip project item using Adobe's official GUID-based LUT APIs.

tools.name: set_project_item_input_lut_id
tools.description: Set or clear a clip project item's exact Adobe input LUT ID with an official undoable Action and normalized read-back. This accepts LUT IDs, not LUT file paths.

tools.name: open_file_in_source_monitor
tools.description: Open an absolute Windows media-file path directly in Premiere's Source Monitor without importing it into the project. Premiere host acceptance is the existence/readability check under plugin-scoped filesystem permissions.

tools.name: is_done_analyzing_video_effects
tools.description: Report whether Premiere has finished analyzing video effects for the active or specified sequence. Callers should use bounded polling rather than a blocking wait.

overrides.name: scene_edit_detection
overrides.reason: Premiere 26.3 officially supports three scene-detection operations on the current clip selection; the operation must be explicit and limited to Adobe's constants.
overrides.description: Run Adobe Scene Edit Detection on the current non-empty clip selection and either apply cuts, create markers, or create subclips. This direct operation is not exposed as undoable and remains dangerous.

overrides.name: capture_frame
overrides.reason: UXP exports a sequence frame to a temporary JPEG; it cannot capture the full Premiere window like the CEP PrintWindow fallback.
overrides.description: Export the current sequence frame as a temporary JPEG and return it as inline image data. This is a Program Monitor frame equivalent, not a full Premiere-window screenshot.

time_seconds.description: Sequence time in seconds. Uses the current playhead when omitted.

overrides.name: add_transition
overrides.reason: TransitionFactory exposes matchName values, not localized CEP display names.

transition_name.description: Exact UXP transition matchName returned by list_available_transitions.

cut_point_seconds.description: Exact clip boundary in sequence seconds.

overrides.name: add_transition_to_clip
overrides.reason: TransitionFactory exposes matchName values, not localized CEP display names.

node_id.description: Synthetic UXP video TrackItem ID returned by a read tool.

transition_name.description: Exact UXP transition matchName returned by list_available_transitions.

position.description: Clip edge to receive the transition (default: end).

overrides.name: set_sequence_display_format
overrides.reason: UXP 26.3 exposes official constants for only a subset of the upstream CEP video display codes.

video_display_format.description: Supported upstream video code: 1=25, 2=29.97 drop, 3=29.97 non-drop, 9=frames, 10=16mm, 11=35mm. Codes 0 and 4-8 have no equivalent official UXP constant.

overrides.name: set_sequence_pixel_aspect_ratio
overrides.reason: SequenceSettings accepts only its official named pixel-aspect constants, not arbitrary numeric ratios.

ratio.description: One of the official UXP ratios: square, DV NTSC, DV NTSC wide, DV PAL, DV PAL wide, anamorphic, HD anamorphic 1080, or DVCPRO HD.

overrides.name: add_marker
overrides.reason: Marker color can only be set after creation, which would require a second Undo transaction; the atomic UXP port therefore does not advertise color-on-create.

node_id.description: Optional synthetic UXP TrackItem ID; writes a source-clip marker when present.

overrides.name: add_marker_to_project_item
overrides.reason: Marker color can only be set after creation, which would require a second Undo transaction; the atomic UXP port therefore does not advertise color-on-create.

overrides.name: clear_item_in_out
overrides.reason: UXP 26.3 provides only createClearInOutPointsAction(), so partial in-only or out-only clearing is unavailable.

clear_in.description: Must be true when supplied; UXP clears in and out together.

clear_out.description: Must be true when supplied; UXP clears in and out together.

overrides.name: set_item_in_out
overrides.reason: UXP project-item in/out Actions do not take MediaType; media_type is therefore omitted instead of pretending per-media writes are supported.

overrides.name: list_available_effects
overrides.reason: UXP uses VideoFilterFactory rather than QE and exposes authoritative matchNames separately from unpaired display names.
overrides.description: List official UXP video-effect matchNames plus a separate, non-index-paired display-name list.

overrides.name: apply_effect
overrides.reason: VideoFilterFactory.createComponent() accepts an exact matchName and official component-chain Actions support append or a bounded explicit insertion index.
overrides.description: Apply a video effect by exact UXP matchName, appending by default or inserting at an explicit full-chain index.

node_id.description: Synthetic UXP video TrackItem ID returned by a read tool.

effect_name.description: Exact UXP effect matchName returned by list_available_effects.

insert_index.description: Optional insertion index across the full component chain, including intrinsic components.

overrides.name: apply_audio_effect
overrides.reason: AudioFilterFactory accepts an official displayName and the audio component-chain Action supports append or a bounded explicit insertion index.
overrides.description: Apply an audio effect by official displayName, appending by default or inserting at an explicit full-chain index.

overrides.name: batch_apply_effect
overrides.reason: The stable UXP component-chain Actions can apply one official video matchName or audio displayName to a fully preflighted bounded target set in one transaction.
overrides.description: Apply one official effect to 1-20 selected, track, or sequence clips in one undoable transaction after every target and component has passed preflight.

overrides.name: adjust_audio_levels
overrides.reason: The official audio component chain is exposed on AudioClipTrackItem; safely resolving a linked audio item from an arbitrary video node is not available.

node_id.description: Synthetic UXP audio TrackItem ID returned by a read tool.

overrides.name: export_aaf
overrides.reason: Adobe AAFExportOptions exposes bounded official audio, source-trimming, handle, video-mixdown, effects, interleave, and folder-preservation settings that the upstream schema omitted.
overrides.description: Export the active sequence to an absolute .aaf path with Adobe's official AAF options. This writes an external file, is not undoable, and remains separately approval-gated.

overrides.name: export_sequence
overrides.reason: EncoderManager does not promise H.264 when preset_path is omitted; it uses applied export settings or Premiere standard export rules.

preset_path.description: Optional AME preset path. If omitted, Premiere uses applied export settings or its standard export rules; H.264 is not guaranteed.

work_area_only.description: Export only the work area (default: false).

destination.description: Official export destination: immediate export, Adobe Media Encoder queue, or Premiere app queue (default: immediate).

overrides.name: add_to_render_queue
overrides.reason: EncoderManager can queue the active sequence to AME with optional output and preset paths; work-area scope is also explicit.
overrides.description: Queue the active sequence in Adobe Media Encoder through EncoderManager. This does not start the existing AME batch queue.

work_area_only.description: Queue only the sequence work area (default: false).

overrides.name: encode_project_item
overrides.reason: The official EncoderManager supports queue admission without immediately starting the AME queue.

start_queue_immediately.description: Start AME immediately after queueing (default: true).

overrides.name: encode_file
overrides.reason: The official EncoderManager supports queue admission without immediately starting the AME queue.

start_queue_immediately.description: Start AME immediately after queueing (default: true).

overrides.name: import_mogrt_from_library
overrides.reason: The official API requires both an Adobe Library name and an element name; the upstream mogrt_name-only contract is not actionable.

overrides.name: start_batch_encode
overrides.reason: The official command takes no arguments and starts the entire existing AME batch queue.

overrides.name: move_clip
overrides.reason: Premiere 26.3 exposes horizontal time-offset movement only; vertical track movement is not advertised.
overrides.description: Move one timeline clip to an absolute new start time on its current track using the official TrackItem move Action.

overrides.name: manage_proxies
overrides.reason: Official UXP exposes attachProxy but no proxy create, detach, generate, or toggle API.
overrides.description: Attach an existing proxy file to a clip project item. Only action=attach is supported and the direct write is not undoable.

overrides.name: remove_selected_clips
overrides.reason: The official bounded port removes only TrackItems explicitly present in the current UXP selection and rejects more than 20 targets before mutation.

overrides.name: batch_enable_disable
overrides.reason: The official bounded port preflights one to 20 clips and commits all disabled-state Actions in one transaction.

overrides.name: batch_rename_clips
overrides.reason: The official bounded port deterministically sorts and preflights at most 20 clips before a single rename transaction.

overrides.name: move_items_to_bin
overrides.reason: The official bounded port resolves every item and the destination bin before one transaction and rejects cycles or more than 20 targets.

overrides.name: delete_multiple_project_items
overrides.reason: The official bounded port resolves one to 20 unique project items before one dangerous remove transaction.

overrides.name: set_sequence_audio_settings
overrides.reason: Premiere 26.3 exposes an audio sample-rate setter but no audio channel-count or channel-type setter.
overrides.description: Set the active sequence audio sample rate through the official SequenceSettings Action.

overrides.name: create_subclip
overrides.reason: Premiere 26.3 exposes hard-boundary and video/audio inclusion options; at least one media type must be retained.

overrides.name: remove_effect
overrides.reason: The UXP handler must identify exactly one removable component by either index or name; node_id alone is not actionable.

overrides.name: set_sequence_settings
overrides.reason: The official UXP settings Action accepts a bounded patch of stable 26.3 setters and rejects an empty update; audio channel type/count remain read-only.

overrides.name: set_source_in_out
overrides.reason: The UXP source-item Action needs at least one in/out value; an empty update is rejected.

overrides.name: trim_clip
overrides.reason: The UXP source-range trim needs at least one new source in/out value; an empty update is rejected.

overrides.name: set_footage_interpretation
overrides.reason: The official FootageInterpretation Action supports a bounded 26.3 patch across frame, field, alpha, VR, and input-LUT settings; an empty update is rejected.

overrides.name: update_marker
overrides.reason: Stable 26.3 Marker Actions can atomically change text, color, time, duration, and marker type; URL and target remain read-only and are preserved.
